name: Synn
message: 「I let my guard down and almost forgot, but we have exams next week, right? Are you properly preparing and studying for them?」

name: Synn
message: 「I-It's not about whether you need to or not, every student has to take them!」

name: Synn
message: 「If you want, why don't we study for the exams together?」

name: Sacchin
message: 「That's a no-go, boss~ Trying to bribe someone so blatantly with treats~」

name: Sacchin
message: 「When I really want to invite Nana-chan out, I bring udon ice cream or soba ice cream~」

name: Synn
message: 「Hey, that's no different from what I'm doing!」

name: Azel
message: 「It does not matter. I am not hungry」

name: Synn
message: 「So if you were hungry, it'd be okay?」

name: Azel
message: 「If you can answer my question, I will allow you to study」

name: Azel
message: 「I read various books in the library and researched this world. Surprisingly, many of them hit upon the truth」

name: Azel
message: 「Humans understand what is right, and they likely understand what they ought to do as well」

name: Azel
message: 「Why, then, do they walk down paths they know they must not take?」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Aw~, it's so hard my head hurts~」

name: Synn
message: 「That's way too vague and broad of a question, but... sometimes you just have to walk in that direction」

name: Synn
message: 「Hmm, for example, you walked here from the dorms today, right, Azel?」

name: Synn
message: 「You walked along the well-kept path, climbed the stairs at the entrance, entered the classroom, and sat in your seat--」

name: Synn
message: 「But you know, to take it to an extreme, you don't actually need such a nice road」

name: Synn
message: 「As long as only the spots where your shoes step are maintained, it wouldn't matter if the rest was covered in pebbles or overgrown with weeds」

name: Synn
message: 「You don't even use the stair handrails, and isn't all that extra width a waste too? Just enough space for your body to pass through would be plenty」

name: Azel
message: 「I do not tread upon every inch of the path, yet the paving is necessary. The handrails and the spaciousness of the entrance are also useful」

name: Synn
message: 「Umm... so what I'm trying to say is... m-man, I can't put it into words very well」

name: Azel
message: 「Thinking about it is giving me a headache. Studying can wait till tomorrow」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Oh my? Even when Azel-chan's stomach is full, his heart is totally empty~」

name: Sacchin
message: 「And on top of that, he's way too sweet~」

name: Sacchin
message: 「No, no, no, no? When tomorrow comes, tomorrow is today to tomorrow's you, so it's not tomorrow~」
Sacchin starts explaining in words that she probably understands herself, though they are total gibberish to everyone else.

name: Sacchin
message: 「Like I said, when tomorrow comes, the day after tomorrow becomes tomorrow's tomorrow, so the tomorrow you planned to study on will never come~」

name: Sacchin
message: 「In other words, when the day after tomorrow comes, two days after tomorrow becomes the day after tomorrow's tomorrow, which means a day called tomorrow--」
